quiz.title: Cybersecurity Quiz for Kids
quiz.description: 90 preguntas sobre ciberseguridad para ninos - nivel mixto

questions.question: What is phishing?
options: A fun fishing game online
A trick to steal your personal information by pretending to be someone trustworthy
A type of sport
A way to make new friends online
questions.answer: A trick to steal your personal information by pretending to be someone trustworthy

questions.question: You receive an email saying you won a prize but need to click a link. What should you do?
options: Click the link immediately
Tell a trusted adult and do not click
Reply with your personal details
Share the email with friends
questions.answer: Tell a trusted adult and do not click

questions.question: Which of these is a warning sign of a scam message?
options: It is from your school teacher
It has a friendly greeting
It asks for personal information urgently
It talks about your homework
questions.answer: It asks for personal information urgently

questions.question: A message says you won a free tablet but must share your home address. What do you do?
options: Give your address right away
Ask a trusted adult before doing anything
Share it only if the offer looks real
Send your school address instead
questions.answer: Ask a trusted adult before doing anything

questions.question: What should you do with an email from someone you do not recognize?
options: Open all attachments inside
Reply to find out who they are
Delete it and tell a trusted adult
Forward it to all your friends
questions.answer: Delete it and tell a trusted adult

questions.question: Someone online offers free game coins if you share your password. What do you do?
options: Share your password for the coins
Ask for even more coins first
Never share your password and tell an adult
Keep it a secret from your parents
questions.answer: Never share your password and tell an adult

questions.question: What does a phishing email often pretend to be?
options: A message from a famous company or trusted person
A letter from your school
A funny joke email
A homework reminder
questions.answer: A message from a famous company or trusted person

questions.question: Which is the safest thing to do when you receive a suspicious message?
options: Click every link to check
Ignore it and do nothing
Tell a trusted adult immediately
Reply and ask questions
questions.answer: Tell a trusted adult immediately

questions.question: Is it safe to click a link in an email if you do not know the sender?
options: Yes, links are always safe
No, it could take you to a harmful website
Only if the link is short
Yes, if the email looks official
questions.answer: No, it could take you to a harmful website

questions.question: What is the goal of a scammer?
options: To help you find information
To steal your personal information or money
To teach you about the internet
To send you free gifts
questions.answer: To steal your personal information or money

questions.question: What does a phishing link usually try to do?
options: Help you find homework answers
Take you to a fake website to steal your data
Speed up your internet connection
Give you access to free games
questions.answer: Take you to a fake website to steal your data

questions.question: What is spear phishing?
options: Phishing using a fishing rod
A targeted attack that uses your personal details to seem more convincing
A safe way to browse the internet
A type of video game
questions.answer: A targeted attack that uses your personal details to seem more convincing

questions.question: How can you check if an email is really from a company you trust?
options: By how colorful the email looks
By checking the sender's email address carefully
By the number of exclamation marks
By how long the message is
questions.answer: By checking the sender's email address carefully

questions.question: What is smishing?
options: A type of online game
Phishing carried out through text messages
A healthy snack
A social media trend
questions.answer: Phishing carried out through text messages

questions.question: What is vishing?
options: A virtual reality game
Phishing carried out through phone calls
A video sharing platform
A type of antivirus software
questions.answer: Phishing carried out through phone calls

questions.question: Why do scammers create urgency in their messages?
options: To be polite
To pressure you into acting quickly without thinking
To give you more time to decide
To make the message look professional
questions.answer: To pressure you into acting quickly without thinking

questions.question: What is a fake website designed to steal your information called?
options: A safe site
A phishing site
A homework site
A search engine
questions.answer: A phishing site

questions.question: Which clue suggests an email might be a phishing attempt?
options: Your name is spelled correctly
The email comes from a strange address with random characters
The email has a professional logo
The email is short and friendly
questions.answer: The email comes from a strange address with random characters

questions.question: What should you do if you accidentally clicked a suspicious link?
options: Pretend it did not happen
Tell a trusted adult immediately and avoid entering any information
Click more links on the page
Share the link with friends
questions.answer: Tell a trusted adult immediately and avoid entering any information

questions.question: Why do phishing emails sometimes look very official?
options: Because they are actually real
Because scammers copy logos and designs to seem trustworthy
Because all emails look the same
Because official emails are easy to make
questions.answer: Because scammers copy logos and designs to seem trustworthy

questions.question: What is a man-in-the-middle attack?
options: When two players compete in a game
When an attacker secretly intercepts communication between two people
When your internet connection is slow
When two friends share a device
questions.answer: When an attacker secretly intercepts communication between two people

questions.question: What technique do scammers use called social engineering?
options: Building robots that can talk
Manipulating people psychologically to reveal confidential information
Designing social media apps
Engineering social networks
questions.answer: Manipulating people psychologically to reveal confidential information

questions.question: What is a homograph attack in phishing?
options: Using similar-looking characters in a domain name to trick users into visiting a fake site
Drawing pictures to trick people
A type of grammar mistake in emails
Sending emails with pictures instead of text
questions.answer: Using similar-looking characters in a domain name to trick users into visiting a fake site

questions.question: What does URL spoofing mean?
options: Creating a fast internet connection
Making a fake web address look like a real trusted one
Deleting a website
Searching for websites faster
questions.answer: Making a fake web address look like a real trusted one

questions.question: What is whaling in cybersecurity?
options: A game about ocean animals
A phishing attack specifically targeting high-profile individuals like executives
A method of secure communication
A type of antivirus software
questions.answer: A phishing attack specifically targeting high-profile individuals like executives

questions.question: What is clone phishing?
options: Copying someone's social media profile
Creating a nearly identical copy of a legitimate email but with malicious links
Making a backup of your emails
Sending the same friendly email twice
questions.answer: Creating a nearly identical copy of a legitimate email but with malicious links

questions.question: What is the best technical way to verify a website is legitimate?
options: Check if it has colorful graphics
Look at the SSL certificate and verify the exact domain name
Count the number of pages it has
Check how fast it loads
questions.answer: Look at the SSL certificate and verify the exact domain name

questions.question: What is pretexting in a phishing attack?
options: Writing text messages
Creating a fabricated scenario to manipulate someone into giving information
Sending a text-only email
Using text formatting in messages
questions.answer: Creating a fabricated scenario to manipulate someone into giving information

questions.question: What does anti-phishing software do?
options: Teaches you how to fish
Detects and blocks phishing attempts before they reach you
Speeds up your internet
Translates foreign emails
questions.answer: Detects and blocks phishing attempts before they reach you

questions.question: Why is multi-factor authentication effective against phishing?
options: It makes passwords longer
Even if your password is stolen, attackers still cannot access your account without a second verification
It blocks all emails
It deletes phishing messages automatically
questions.answer: Even if your password is stolen, attackers still cannot access your account without a second verification

questions.question: What does the padlock symbol in your browser mean?
options: The website is locked and you cannot use it
The website uses a secure and encrypted connection
The website is your favorite
The website is free to use
questions.answer: The website uses a secure and encrypted connection

questions.question: What should you do before clicking a link you are unsure about?
options: Click it immediately out of curiosity
Check if it looks safe and ask a trusted adult
Share it with friends first
Always avoid all links
questions.answer: Check if it looks safe and ask a trusted adult

questions.question: Is it safe to use public Wi-Fi to log into your accounts?
options: Yes, public Wi-Fi is always safe
No, public Wi-Fi is not secure and others could see your data
Yes, if you use a password
Only if you use it quickly
questions.answer: No, public Wi-Fi is not secure and others could see your data

questions.question: What should you do if you see something upsetting or scary online?
options: Keep watching to understand it
Share it with your friends
Close it and tell a trusted adult
Ignore it and continue browsing
questions.answer: Close it and tell a trusted adult

questions.question: Why is it important to keep your apps and software updated?
options: Updates make apps look more colorful
Updates fix security problems that protect your device
Updates add more advertisements
Updates are not really important
questions.answer: Updates fix security problems that protect your device

questions.question: What does HTTPS mean at the start of a website address?
options: Happy To Help People Stay Safe
The website uses a secure protocol to protect your data
High Tech Phone Transfer System
The website is free
questions.answer: The website uses a secure protocol to protect your data

questions.question: Should you download files from websites you do not recognize?
options: Yes, free files are always safe
No, unknown files can contain harmful software
Only small files are safe
Yes, if the website looks nice
questions.answer: No, unknown files can contain harmful software

questions.question: What should you always do after using a shared computer at school or a library?
options: Leave everything open for the next person
Log out of all your accounts
Save all your passwords on the computer
Delete the browser history only
questions.answer: Log out of all your accounts

questions.question: Which of these is a safe place to download apps?
options: Random websites you find in search results
Official app stores like Google Play or Apple App Store
Links sent by strangers in messages
Pop-up advertisements
questions.answer: Official app stores like Google Play or Apple App Store

questions.question: What should you do if a pop-up appears saying your device has a virus and asks you to click download?
options: Click download immediately
Close the pop-up and tell a trusted adult
Read the full message and then click
Share the pop-up with friends
questions.answer: Close the pop-up and tell a trusted adult

questions.question: What is a VPN and why can it help keep you safer online?
options: A Very Popular Network for streaming videos
A Virtual Private Network that encrypts your connection and hides your activity
A Verified Personal Name used on social media
A Video Play Now service for kids
questions.answer: A Virtual Private Network that encrypts your connection and hides your activity

questions.question: What is malware?
options: A healthy food for your device
Software designed to damage or gain unauthorized access to a computer
A fun downloadable game
A new social media platform for teens
questions.answer: Software designed to damage or gain unauthorized access to a computer

questions.question: What is a firewall?
options: A physical wall built around your house
A security system that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic
A type of antivirus game
A website filter for kids
questions.answer: A security system that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic

questions.question: What does antivirus software do?
options: Helps you record videos
Detects and removes harmful software from your device
Makes your internet connection faster
Translates foreign websites
questions.answer: Detects and removes harmful software from your device

questions.question: What is a computer worm?
options: An animal that lives inside computers
A type of malware that copies itself and spreads across networks without user action
A safe program that cleans your device
A type of antivirus software
questions.answer: A type of malware that copies itself and spreads across networks without user action

questions.question: What is ransomware?
options: A game where you win real money
Malware that locks your files and demands payment to restore access
A type of safe cloud storage
A fun app for editing photos
questions.answer: Malware that locks your files and demands payment to restore access

questions.question: What is a Trojan horse in cybersecurity?
options: An ancient history lesson
Malware disguised as a legitimate and useful program
A type of antivirus software
A board game about cyber safety
questions.answer: Malware disguised as a legitimate and useful program

questions.question: Why is it important to back up your data?
options: To free up space on your device
To keep a safe copy of your files in case they are lost, deleted or attacked
To make your device run faster
Backing up is not really necessary
questions.answer: To keep a safe copy of your files in case they are lost, deleted or attacked

questions.question: What is encryption?
options: A type of strong password
The process of converting data into a code so only authorized people can read it
A kind of antivirus program
A social media privacy filter
questions.answer: The process of converting data into a code so only authorized people can read it

questions.question: What are browser cookies?
options: Delicious snacks you can order online
Small files stored on your device that track your browsing preferences and activity
Images that appear on websites
A type of download
questions.answer: Small files stored on your device that track your browsing preferences and activity

questions.question: What does a zero-day vulnerability mean?
options: A new website launched today
A software flaw that is exploited by attackers before the developer has released a fix
A device that runs out of battery in zero days
A virus that disappears after one day
questions.answer: A software flaw that is exploited by attackers before the developer has released a fix

questions.question: What is a botnet?
options: A social network for robots
A network of infected devices controlled by an attacker to carry out malicious tasks
A safe internet network for schools
A type of firewall
questions.answer: A network of infected devices controlled by an attacker to carry out malicious tasks

questions.question: What is a DDoS attack?
options: A game where players defend a digital castle
Flooding a server with massive traffic to make it unavailable to real users
A type of secure connection
A method for backing up data
questions.answer: Flooding a server with massive traffic to make it unavailable to real users

questions.question: What is two-factor authentication and why is it important?
options: Logging in from two different devices at once
A security process requiring two forms of verification, making it much harder for attackers to access accounts
Using two different passwords for the same account
A feature that doubles your internet speed
questions.answer: A security process requiring two forms of verification, making it much harder for attackers to access accounts

questions.question: What is the principle of least privilege in cybersecurity?
options: Giving all users full access to everything
Granting users only the minimum level of access they need to do their job
Letting the least experienced person manage security
Restricting internet access to administrators only
questions.answer: Granting users only the minimum level of access they need to do their job

questions.question: What does SQL injection mean?
options: Injecting vitamins into a database
Inserting malicious code into a database query to manipulate or steal data
A safe way to enter information into a form
A type of database software update
questions.answer: Inserting malicious code into a database query to manipulate or steal data

questions.question: What is a digital certificate used for?
options: Proving you completed an online course
Verifying the identity of a website or user and establishing a secure connection
Storing your passwords
Blocking malicious websites
questions.answer: Verifying the identity of a website or user and establishing a secure connection

questions.question: What is ethical hacking?
options: Hacking games to get extra lives
Authorized testing of computer systems to find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers do
Sharing other people's passwords with permission
Bypassing parental controls with permission
questions.answer: Authorized testing of computer systems to find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers do

questions.question: What is a honeypot in cybersecurity?
options: A sweet reward for good online behavior
A decoy system set up to lure and detect attackers
A safe messaging app for kids
A type of firewall protection
questions.answer: A decoy system set up to lure and detect attackers

questions.question: What does the CIA triad stand for in cybersecurity?
options: Central Internet Agency
Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability - the three core principles of information security
Computer Intelligence and Access
Cybersecurity Investigation Agency
questions.answer: Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability - the three core principles of information security

questions.question: What is the minimum age to join most social media platforms?
options: 8 years old
10 years old
13 years old
18 years old
questions.answer: 13 years old

questions.question: Should you accept friend requests from people you do not know in real life?
options: Yes, the more friends the better
No, only accept people you know personally
Yes, if their profile looks friendly
Only if they have many followers
questions.answer: No, only accept people you know personally

questions.question: Is it safe to post a photo of your school uniform on social media?
options: Yes, it looks great
No, it can reveal where you go to school
Only if your face is hidden
Yes, everyone posts school photos
questions.answer: No, it can reveal where you go to school

questions.question: What should your social media profile be set to if you are a child?
options: Public so everyone can follow you
Private so only approved people can see your posts
Friends of friends only
No settings are needed
questions.answer: Private so only approved people can see your posts

questions.question: Is it safe to share your daily location on social media stories?
options: Yes, it is fun to share your day
No, strangers can track where you are
Only share your home location
Yes, if your account is public
questions.answer: No, strangers can track where you are

questions.question: What should you do if someone online makes you feel uncomfortable?
options: Continue talking to them
Keep it a secret
Block them and tell a trusted adult
Share their messages with classmates
questions.answer: Block them and tell a trusted adult

questions.question: Should you use your real full name as your social media username?
options: Yes, it helps people find you
No, it makes it easier for strangers to identify you
Yes, real names look more professional
Only use your first name
questions.answer: No, it makes it easier for strangers to identify you

questions.question: What does it mean to block someone on social media?
options: Send them a warning message
Prevent them from viewing your profile or contacting you
Delete your account
Report them to the police
questions.answer: Prevent them from viewing your profile or contacting you

questions.question: Is it okay to share your home address on social media?
options: Yes, if your account is private
No, your home address is personal and private information
Only the city name is fine
Yes, so friends can visit you
questions.answer: No, your home address is personal and private information

questions.question: What should you think about before posting something online?
options: How many likes it will get
Whether you would be comfortable if your parents, teacher or strangers saw it
How funny it looks
How quickly you can post it
questions.answer: Whether you would be comfortable if your parents, teacher or strangers saw it

questions.question: What is a digital footprint?
options: Your shoe size measured online
The trail of data and information you leave behind whenever you use the internet
Your profile picture
A type of online game score
questions.answer: The trail of data and information you leave behind whenever you use the internet

questions.question: What is catfishing?
options: A game about catching fish online
When someone creates a fake online identity to deceive or manipulate others
A type of phishing scam
A social media trend for fun
questions.answer: When someone creates a fake online identity to deceive or manipulate others

questions.question: What is oversharing online?
options: Sharing too many funny videos
Posting excessive personal information that could put your safety or privacy at risk
Having too many social media followers
Liking too many posts in one day
questions.answer: Posting excessive personal information that could put your safety or privacy at risk

questions.question: What does it mean to report someone on social media?
options: Send them an angry message
Notify the platform about harmful, inappropriate or suspicious behavior
Delete your account to avoid them
Add them as a friend to monitor them
questions.answer: Notify the platform about harmful, inappropriate or suspicious behavior

questions.question: Why is geotagging your photos potentially risky?
options: It uses too much storage
It reveals your exact location which strangers could use to find you
It makes photos look blurry
It slows down your phone
questions.answer: It reveals your exact location which strangers could use to find you

questions.question: What is cyberbullying?
options: Playing competitive games online
Using technology to repeatedly harm, harass or humiliate another person
Sending too many messages to a friend
Making fun of video game characters
questions.answer: Using technology to repeatedly harm, harass or humiliate another person

questions.question: Once you post something online, can you always delete it completely?
options: Yes, deleting always removes it forever
No, others may have already saved, copied or shared it
Yes, if you delete it within one hour
Only paid accounts can delete permanently
questions.answer: No, others may have already saved, copied or shared it

questions.question: What should you do if someone asks to meet you in person after only knowing you online?
options: Go alone if they seem trustworthy
Never meet without telling a trusted adult and bringing them along
Agree to meet if they send a photo first
Share the meeting details with a classmate
questions.answer: Never meet without telling a trusted adult and bringing them along

questions.question: What information should you NEVER share publicly on social media?
options: Your favorite music
Your phone number, home address and school name
Your hobbies and interests
Your favorite sports team
questions.answer: Your phone number, home address and school name

questions.question: What is the purpose of a privacy setting on a social media app?
options: To change the color theme of your profile
To control who can see your posts, stories and personal information
To block all advertisements
To make your account load faster
questions.answer: To control who can see your posts, stories and personal information

questions.question: What is data harvesting on social media platforms?
options: Collecting crops in a farming game
The large-scale collection of user data by platforms for purposes like targeted advertising
Saving your favorite posts
Downloading your profile backup
questions.answer: The large-scale collection of user data by platforms for purposes like targeted advertising

questions.question: What does end-to-end encryption in a messaging app mean?
options: Messages are deleted at both ends automatically
Only the sender and recipient can read the messages, nobody in between including the company
The message is encrypted only when it arrives
Messages are stored securely on company servers
questions.answer: Only the sender and recipient can read the messages, nobody in between including the company

questions.question: What is a shadow ban on social media?
options: Using a dark mode theme on your profile
When a platform secretly limits your content visibility without notifying you
Blocking someone without them knowing
Hiding your profile from search engines
questions.answer: When a platform secretly limits your content visibility without notifying you

questions.question: What are Terms of Service on social media platforms?
options: Instructions on how to use the app features
Legal agreements outlining the rules and rights users accept when using a platform
A list of banned words on the platform
A guide to setting up your profile
questions.answer: Legal agreements outlining the rules and rights users accept when using a platform

questions.question: What is the right to be forgotten in digital privacy?
options: The right to forget your password
The legal right to request that personal data about you be deleted from online platforms
The right to delete other people's posts
The right to remain anonymous when posting
questions.answer: The legal right to request that personal data about you be deleted from online platforms

questions.question: What is a deepfake?
options: A very deep dive into someone's profile
Artificially generated media where a person's likeness is replaced with someone else's to spread misinformation
A private social media account
A type of profile verification
questions.answer: Artificially generated media where a person's likeness is replaced with someone else's to spread misinformation

questions.question: What does GDPR stand for and why does it matter?
options: Global Digital Privacy Rules
General Data Protection Regulation - a law protecting how companies collect and use personal data
Great Design for Public Relations
General Device Protection Requirements
questions.answer: General Data Protection Regulation - a law protecting how companies collect and use personal data

questions.question: What is doxxing?
options: Adding decorations to your profile
Publicly revealing someone's private personal information online without their consent, often to cause harm
Sending someone a document
Blocking multiple users at once
questions.answer: Publicly revealing someone's private personal information online without their consent, often to cause harm

questions.question: What is account verification on social media?
options: Checking your spelling before posting
A process where platforms confirm the identity of notable accounts, usually shown with a badge
Verifying your number of followers
Checking your account for viruses
questions.answer: A process where platforms confirm the identity of notable accounts, usually shown with a badge

questions.question: What is behavioral advertising on social media?
options: Advertising good online behavior
Targeting ads to users based on their online activity, interests and personal data
Advertising classes on social behavior
Showing the same ads to all users equally
questions.answer: Targeting ads to users based on their online activity, interests and personal data
